doc.title: Norman Simmons interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 27, 2007 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Closing and Ellington project
summary: Rowe wraps up and thanks Simmons, who hopes to bring the Ellington project to Hamilton.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well we’re about to run out of tape. We’ve been talking a long time but I love your comments and I wish you the best of luck with your Ellington project and all the good things you do.
Well I hope we will have a chance to bring that project up here.
Because I think it’s something that you in particular would enjoy and everyone else would enjoy that particular project.
All right. Well thanks for your time again.
Thank you, it was a pleasure.
